## Changelog

- [core] Reduce known Qwen3-ASR instruction echoes in windowed partials
and finals. Keep the original wording with changing voiced speech or
audio-only agreement within one word edit. Quiet or misrecognized
dictation can be dropped, with an empty-transcript error if no text
survives ([#2088](https://github.com/leehack/llamadart/issues/2088)).
